decisions.choice: my lord: a respectful address to a man
decisions.reason: Hannah speaks to the priest as to a man of higher rank; this is not the title used for God.

decisions.choice: hard of spirit: weighed down with trouble
decisions.reason: The phrase is found only here. "Hard" is used elsewhere of a heavy lot, such as hard labor (Exodus 6:9). Hannah is not light-headed with drink, as Eli thinks, but heavy with grief.

decisions.choice: strong drink: intoxicating drink other than wine
decisions.reason: Shekhar is any intoxicating drink, such as beer made from grain or drink made from other fruit. Wine and strong drink are named together in the Nazirite law (Numbers 6:3) and in the rule for priests on duty (Leviticus 10:9).

decisions.choice: poured out my soul: told Yahweh all her grief
decisions.reason: To pour out one's soul or heart is to empty out everything one feels before God (Psalm 42:5; 62:9; Lamentations 2:19). Hannah has not been pouring drink; she has been pouring out herself.

decisions.choice: beer
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "strong drink"; Balanced and Readable say "beer", as in Numbers 6:3 (m3).

decisions.choice: sir; a very unhappy woman; telling the LORD all my sorrow
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday polite address and gives the sense of the two idioms (m2, m4).

decisions.choice: "mon seigneur" (lowercase) to Eli
decisions.reason: A respectful address to a man (m1), written in two words and lowercase so that it is not read as the title of a bishop or as the Lord; Readable says "monsieur", as the English says "sir".

decisions.choice: "tú" to one person, with "mi señor" (L, B) or "señor" (R) as the courteous address
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note and the published Pentateuch: one person is addressed with "tú", the priest and the king included; respect is carried by "mi señor", "mi señor el rey" and "tu siervo" / "tu sierva". Readable says "señor" where the English Readable says "sir".

decisions.choice: bwana wangu (L, B); bwana (R)
decisions.reason: "Bwana" in lowercase is the ordinary respectful address to a man in Swahili, so it serves both "my lord" and the English Readable "sir".

decisions.choice: kileo (L); pombe (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the general word for any intoxicating drink (m3); Balanced and Readable use "pombe", the everyday word for beer and brewed drink, as the English says "beer".

decisions.choice: "chúa tôi" (L, B), "thưa ông" (R) for "my lord" to a man
decisions.reason: The Genesis terms note sets "chúa tôi" or "ông" for *adoni*; Readable has "sir", which is "thưa ông". Lowercase "chúa" marks a human lord.

decisions.choice: "rượu nho hay rượu mạnh" (B); "rượu" (R) for wine and strong drink
decisions.reason: The English "beer" names a drink Vietnamese readers would not picture at an ancient sanctuary; "rượu mạnh" says intoxicating drink (meaning decision), and Readable folds the pair into "rượu".

decisions.choice: "내 주여" (L); "제사장님" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "내 주여" in Korean sounds like an address to God; Balanced and Readable give the respect of "my lord" with Eli's title, as the English Readable gives "sir".

decisions.choice: "맥주"
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable "beer"; Literal keeps "독주", strong drink.

decisions.choice: meu senhor (L, B), senhor (R); the speaker's "o senhor" and "a sua serva" to Eli
decisions.reason: For the whole book: people speak up to a priest, a prophet, a king or a master with "o senhor" and "meu senhor" (docs/portuguese-style.md section 4), and, where the Hebrew uses it, the courtly third person "a sua serva", "o seu servo" (verse 16). Eli, the superior, says "você" to Hannah (verse 14). This is not the title used for God (m1), and the lowercase keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: atribulada de espírito
decisions.reason: Portuguese "dura de espírito" would sound like stubbornness, the opposite of what Hannah says (m2); "atribulada" keeps the image of a heavy weight on the spirit.

source.text: אַל־תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י בַּת־בְּלִיָּ֑עַל כִּֽי־מֵרֹ֥ב שִׂיחִ֛י וְכַעְסִ֖י דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי עַד־הֵֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not give your maidservant before [the] face of a daughter of worthlessness, for from [the] abundance of my complaint and my provocation I have spoken until now.

en.L: Do not regard your maidservant as a daughter of worthlessness, for out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation I have spoken until now."
en.B: Do not take your servant for a worthless woman. All this time I have been speaking out of my great anguish and distress."
en.R: Please do not think I am a wicked woman. I have been praying here so long because I am so troubled and hurt."

es.L: No tengas a tu sierva por una hija de perversidad, porque por la abundancia de mi queja y de mi aflicción he hablado hasta ahora».
es.B: No tomes a tu sierva por una mujer perversa. Todo este tiempo he estado hablando por mi gran angustia y aflicción».
es.R: Por favor, no pienses que soy una mala mujer. He estado orando aquí tanto tiempo porque estoy muy angustiada y dolida».

fr.L: Ne mets pas ta servante au rang d’une fille de vaurien, car c’est de l’abondance de ma plainte et de mon chagrin que j’ai parlé jusqu’à maintenant. »
fr.B: Ne prends pas ta servante pour une femme de rien. Si j’ai parlé si longtemps, c’est à cause de ma grande angoisse et de ma détresse. »
fr.R: Je t’en prie, ne pense pas que je suis une mauvaise femme. Si je prie ici depuis si longtemps, c’est parce que j’ai beaucoup de peine et que je suis blessée. »

sw.L: Usimhesabu mjakazi wako kuwa binti wa ubaya, kwa maana kwa wingi wa malalamiko yangu na uchungu wangu nimesema mpaka sasa."
sw.B: Usimdhanie mtumishi wako kuwa mwanamke asiyefaa kitu. Muda huu wote nimekuwa nikisema kutokana na dhiki na huzuni yangu kubwa."
sw.R: Tafadhali usidhani kwamba mimi ni mwanamke mwovu. Nimekuwa nikiomba hapa kwa muda mrefu kwa sababu nina taabu na maumivu mengi moyoni."

vi.L: Xin đừng xem tớ gái của ông như một đứa con gái của sự gian tà, vì tôi đã nói cho đến bây giờ là do quá nhiều nỗi than thở và nỗi tức tối của tôi."
vi.B: Xin đừng coi đầy tớ của ông là người đàn bà hư hỏng. Bấy lâu nay tôi nói là vì lòng tôi quá đau đớn và sầu khổ."
vi.R: Xin ông đừng nghĩ tôi là người đàn bà xấu xa. Tôi cầu nguyện ở đây lâu như vậy là vì tôi quá buồn khổ và đau lòng."

ko.L: 이 여종을 불량한 여자로 여기지 마십시오. 제가 지금까지 말한 것은 제 근심과 격분이 많아서였습니다."
ko.B: 이 종을 몹쓸 여자로 여기지 마십시오. 지금까지 저는 너무나 괴롭고 답답해서 말씀드리고 있었던 것입니다."
ko.R: 저를 나쁜 여자로 생각하지 말아 주십시오. 제가 여기서 이렇게 오래 기도한 것은 너무 괴롭고 마음이 아팠기 때문입니다."

pt.L: Não considere a sua serva uma filha de perversidade, pois foi da abundância da minha queixa e da minha aflição [que] falei até agora."
pt.B: Não tome a sua serva por uma mulher perversa. Todo esse tempo eu estive falando por causa da minha grande angústia e aflição."
pt.R: Por favor, não pense que eu sou uma mulher má. Eu fiquei orando aqui todo esse tempo porque estou muito aflita e magoada."

decisions.choice: do not give your maidservant before a daughter of worthlessness: do not take me for a worthless woman
decisions.reason: "Daughter of" describes character: a "daughter of belial" is a woman of no worth, a disgrace. The same word is used of Eli's own sons, "sons of belial" (2:12).

decisions.choice: my complaint: troubled thoughts poured out in words
decisions.reason: Siach is anxious thinking and the outpouring of it in words, often in prayer (Psalm 142:3; Job 7:13).

decisions.choice: my provocation: the grief of being provoked
decisions.reason: It is the same word as in verses 6 and 7: what Peninnah's taunts have done to her.

decisions.choice: anguish and distress (Balanced); so troubled and hurt (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "complaint" and "provocation"; Balanced and Readable give their sense (m2, m3). Readable adds "here so long" for "until now".
Hannah's "your maidservant" to Eli; "당신" to an older priest would be rude in Korean, so Literal and Balanced say "this servant" and Readable says "I", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: filha de perversidade (L); mulher perversa (B); mulher má (R)
decisions.reason: As Judges 19:22 has the same word in Portuguese, "filhos de perversidade" (L), "homens perversos" (B), "homens maus" (R): the phrase describes character (m1). The same words return for Eli's sons in 2:12, where the echo matters.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַן עֵלִ֛י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לְכִ֣י לְשָׁל֑וֹם וֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל יִתֵּן֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣לָתֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתְּ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered Eli and said, Go in peace, and [the] God of Israel grant your petition which you have asked from with him.

en.L: And Eli answered and said, "Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: Eli answered, "Go in peace. May the God of Israel grant what you have asked of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Then Eli said, "Go in peace. May the God of Israel give you what you have asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for."

es.L: Y Elí respondió y dijo: «Ve en paz, y que el Dios de Israel te conceda la petición que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} has pedido».
es.B: Elí le respondió: «Ve en paz. Que el Dios de Israel te conceda lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} has pedido».
es.R: Entonces Elí le dijo: «Ve en paz. Que el Dios de Israel te dé lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} has pedido».

fr.L: Et Éli répondit et dit : « Va en paix, et que le Dieu d’Israël t’accorde la demande que tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} as demandée. »
fr.B: Éli lui répondit : « Va en paix. Que le Dieu d’Israël t’accorde ce que tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} as demandé. »
fr.R: Alors Éli lui a dit : « Va en paix. Que le Dieu d’Israël te donne ce que tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} as demandé. »

sw.L: Na Eli akajibu, akasema, "Nenda kwa amani, na Mungu wa Israeli akupe ombi lako ulilomwomba."
sw.B: Eli akajibu, "Nenda kwa amani. Mungu wa Israeli akujalie kile ulichomwomba."
sw.R: Ndipo Eli akasema, "Nenda kwa amani. Mungu wa Israeli akupe kile ulichomwomba."

vi.L: Hê-li đáp và nói: "Hãy đi bình an, và nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên ban cho bà điều bà đã cầu xin nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Hê-li đáp: "Hãy đi bình an. Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên ban cho bà điều bà đã cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Hê-li nói: "Hãy về bình an. Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên ban cho bà điều bà đã xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 그러자 엘리가 대답하여 말했다. "평안히 가거라. 이스라엘의 하나님께서 네가 그분께 구한 네 간구를 들어주시기를 바란다."
ko.B: 엘리가 대답했다. "평안히 가거라. 이스라엘의 하나님께서 네가 그분께 구한 것을 이루어 주시기를 빈다."
ko.R: 그러자 엘리가 말했다. "평안히 가거라. 이스라엘의 하나님께서 네가 구한 것을 주시기를 바란다."

pt.L: E Eli respondeu e disse: "Vá em paz, e o Deus de Israel lhe conceda o seu pedido, que você pediu a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.B: Eli respondeu: "Vá em paz. Que o Deus de Israel lhe conceda o pedido que você fez a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.R: Então Eli disse: "Vá em paz. Que o Deus de Israel dê a você aquilo que você pediu a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."

decisions.choice: may he grant: a blessing
alternatives: the God of Israel will grant
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as a wish, "may he grant", or as a promise, "he will grant". Spoken by the priest as he sends her away, it is a blessing, and Hannah receives it with hope (verse 18).

decisions.choice: your petition that you asked: the key word of the story
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb come from sha'al, "to ask". The word returns when Hannah names her son (verse 20) and when she gives him to Yahweh (verses 27-28), and it sounds like the name Saul, sha'ul, "asked for", the king whom Israel will ask for (8:10; 12:13).

decisions.choice: Go in peace: a farewell blessing
decisions.reason: Shalom is wholeness and well-being. The words send her away with good wishes (Judges 18:6; 2 Kings 5:19).

decisions.choice: "그분" with the honorific, and no deity_pronoun span
alternatives: a deity_pronoun span as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters; respect for God is carried by "그분" and "-시-" at every level, as the Korean style guide sets. Used for the whole block.

decisions.choice: o pedido, pedir (L, B); pedir (R)
decisions.reason: The key word of the story (m2): Portuguese "pedir" and "pedido" share a root as the Hebrew noun and verb do, so the same pair returns when Hannah names her son, "eu o pedi" (verse 20), and when she tells Eli "o pedido que eu fiz" (verse 27). Balanced and Readable keep at least the verb in each place.

source.text: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר תִּמְצָ֧א שִׁפְחָתְךָ֛ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וַתֵּ֨לֶךְ הָאִשָּׁ֤ה לְדַרְכָּהּ֙ וַתֹּאכַ֔ל וּפָנֶ֥יהָ לֹא־הָיוּ־לָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said, May find your maidservant favor in your eyes. And went the woman on her way, and she ate, and her face was not to her anymore.

en.L: And she said, "May your maidservant find favor in your eyes." And the woman went on her way and ate, and her face was no longer [sad].
en.B: She said, "May your servant find favor in your sight." Then the woman went her way and ate, and her face was no longer downcast.
en.R: Hannah answered, "Thank you, sir. I hope you will always think well of me." Then she went away and ate something, and she no longer looked sad.

es.L: Y ella dijo: «Halle tu sierva gracia ante tus ojos». Y la mujer se fue por su camino y comió, y su rostro ya no estuvo [triste].
es.B: Ella dijo: «Que tu sierva halle favor ante tus ojos». Luego la mujer se fue por su camino y comió, y su rostro ya no estaba abatido.
es.R: Ana respondió: «Gracias, señor. Ojalá siempre pienses bien de mí». Luego se fue, comió algo y ya no parecía triste.

fr.L: Et elle dit : « Que ta servante trouve grâce à tes yeux. » Et la femme s’en alla son chemin, et elle mangea, et son visage ne fut plus [triste].
fr.B: Elle dit : « Que ta servante trouve grâce à tes yeux. » Puis la femme s’en alla, elle mangea, et son visage n’était plus abattu.
fr.R: Anne a répondu : « Merci, monsieur. J’espère que tu penseras toujours du bien de moi. » Puis elle est partie et elle a mangé quelque chose. Elle n’avait plus l’air triste.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Mjakazi wako na apate kibali machoni pako." Na yule mwanamke akaenda zake, akala, na uso wake haukuwa [wa huzuni] tena.
sw.B: Akasema, "Mtumishi wako na apate kibali mbele yako." Kisha yule mwanamke akaenda zake akala, na uso wake haukuwa na huzuni tena.
sw.R: Hana akajibu, "Asante, bwana. Natumaini utaniwazia mema siku zote." Kisha akaondoka, akala chakula, na hakuonekana tena kuwa na huzuni.

vi.L: Nàng nói: "Nguyện tớ gái của ông được ơn trong mắt ông." Rồi người đàn bà đi đường mình và ăn, và mặt nàng không còn [buồn] nữa.
vi.B: Nàng nói: "Nguyện đầy tớ của ông được ơn trước mặt ông." Rồi người đàn bà ra đi, ăn uống, và nét mặt nàng không còn ủ rũ nữa.
vi.R: An-ne đáp: "Cảm ơn ông. Mong ông luôn nghĩ tốt về tôi." Rồi nàng đi ăn, và nét mặt nàng không còn buồn nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 말했다. "이 여종이 제사장님의 눈에 은혜를 입기를 바랍니다." 그리고 그 여자는 제 길을 가서 먹었고, 그 여자의 얼굴이 더 이상 [어둡지] 않았다.
ko.B: 한나가 말했다. "이 종을 좋게 보아 주십시오." 그러고 나서 한나는 자기 길을 가서 음식을 먹었고, 얼굴에 더는 근심이 없었다.
ko.R: 한나가 대답했다. "고맙습니다, 제사장님. 저를 늘 좋게 생각해 주십시오." 그러고 나서 한나는 돌아가서 음식을 먹었다. 이제 한나의 얼굴은 더 이상 슬퍼 보이지 않았다.

pt.L: E ela disse: "Que a sua criada encontre favor aos seus olhos." E a mulher seguiu o seu caminho e comeu, e o seu rosto não [estava] mais [triste].
pt.B: Ela disse: "Que a sua serva encontre favor aos seus olhos." Então a mulher seguiu o seu caminho e comeu, e o seu rosto já não estava abatido.
pt.R: Ana respondeu: "Obrigada, senhor. Espero que o senhor sempre pense bem de mim." Depois ela foi embora e comeu alguma coisa, e não parecia mais triste.

decisions.choice: your maidservant: a humbler word
decisions.reason: Here she uses shifchah, a humbler word for a servant girl than the 'amah of verses 11 and 16 (compare Ruth 2:13). She answers the priest with thanks and respect.

decisions.choice: find favor in your eyes: may you think kindly of me
decisions.reason: This is a polite way to thank someone or to ask that they stay kind (Genesis 33:15; Ruth 2:13).

decisions.choice: her face was no longer hers: she no longer looked sad
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "her face was not to her anymore", a short expression whose sense is clear from the story: the downcast face of verses 7-8 was gone. The ancient Greek reads "her face did not fall anymore". Hannah ate the meal she had refused (verse 7), because her grief had lifted.

decisions.choice: her face was no longer [sad]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the word the short Hebrew expression implies (m3).

decisions.choice: Thank you, sir. I hope you will always think well of me.
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the polite formula (m2) and puts Hannah's words in the first person.

decisions.choice: "제사장님의 눈에" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "in your eyes" but names Eli by his title, since "당신" would be rude here.

decisions.choice: a sua criada (L); a sua serva (B)
decisions.reason: Shifchah is a humbler word than the 'amah of verses 11 and 16 (m1): Literal marks the difference with "criada", as in Ruth 2:13; Balanced says "a sua serva", the courtly way a woman spoke of herself to a superior.

source.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֛בוּ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־בֵּיתָ֖ם הָרָמָ֑תָה וַיֵּ֤דַע אֶלְקָנָה֙ אֶת־חַנָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיִּֽזְכְּרֶ֖הָ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they rose early in the morning and bowed down before Yahweh, and they returned and came to their house, to Ramah. And knew Elkanah Hannah his wife, and remembered her Yahweh.

en.L: And they rose early in the morning and worshiped before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they returned and came to their house at Ramah. And Elkanah knew Hannah his wife, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} remembered her.
en.B: Early the next morning they worshiped before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and then went back home to Ramah. Elkanah lay with his wife Hannah, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} remembered her.
en.R: Early the next morning the family worshiped {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then they went back home to Ramah. Elkanah slept with his wife Hannah, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} remembered her and answered her prayer.

es.L: Y se levantaron de madrugada y adoraron delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y volvieron y llegaron a su casa en Ramá. Y Elcana conoció a Ana su esposa, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se acordó de ella.
es.B: A la mañana siguiente, muy temprano, adoraron delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y luego regresaron a su casa en Ramá. Elcana se unió a su esposa Ana, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se acordó de ella.
es.R: Muy temprano a la mañana siguiente, la familia adoró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Después regresaron a su casa en Ramá. Elcana tuvo relaciones con su esposa Ana, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se acordó de ella y respondió a su oración.

fr.L: Et ils se levèrent de bon matin et se prosternèrent devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils s’en retournèrent et vinrent à leur maison, à Rama. Et Elqana connut Anne sa femme, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se souvint d’elle.
fr.B: Le lendemain, de bon matin, ils adorèrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, puis ils rentrèrent chez eux à Rama. Elqana s’unit à sa femme Anne, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se souvint d’elle.
fr.R: Le lendemain, très tôt, toute la famille a adoré {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Puis ils sont rentrés chez eux, à Rama. Elqana a dormi avec sa femme Anne, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est souvenu d’elle et a répondu à sa prière.

sw.L: Nao wakaamka asubuhi na mapema, wakaabudu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kisha wakarudi wakafika nyumbani kwao Rama. Na Elkana akamjua Hana mkewe, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamkumbuka.
sw.B: Asubuhi na mapema wakaabudu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kisha wakarudi nyumbani Rama. Elkana akalala na mkewe Hana, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamkumbuka.
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata, jamaa yote ilimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kisha wakarudi nyumbani Rama. Elkana akalala na mkewe Hana, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamkumbuka na kujibu maombi yake.

vi.L: Họ dậy sớm vào buổi sáng và thờ lạy trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi trở về và đến nhà mình tại Ra-ma. Ên-ca-na ăn ở với An-ne vợ mình, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhớ đến nàng.
vi.B: Sáng hôm sau họ dậy sớm, thờ phượng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi trở về nhà tại Ra-ma. Ên-ca-na ăn ở với An-ne vợ mình, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhớ đến nàng.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau cả nhà thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Rồi họ trở về nhà ở Ra-ma. Ên-ca-na ăn ở với An-ne vợ mình, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhớ đến nàng và nhậm lời nàng cầu xin.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 아침에 일찍 일어나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 경배하고, 돌아가서 라마에 있는 자기 집에 이르렀다. 그리고 엘가나가 자기 아내 한나와 동침했고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 여자를 기억하셨다.
ko.B: 다음 날 아침 일찍 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 경배하고 라마에 있는 집으로 돌아갔다. 엘가나가 아내 한나와 잠자리를 같이하니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한나를 기억하셨다.
ko.R: 다음 날 아침 일찍 엘가나의 가족은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 예배했다. 그러고 나서 라마에 있는 집으로 돌아갔다. 엘가나가 아내 한나와 잠자리를 같이했고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 한나를 기억하시고 그 기도에 응답하셨다.

pt.L: E eles se levantaram cedo de manhã e adoraram diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e voltaram e chegaram à sua casa em Ramá. E Elcana conheceu Ana, sua mulher, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se lembrou dela.
pt.B: Na manhã seguinte, bem cedo, eles adoraram diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e depois voltaram para casa, em Ramá. Elcana se deitou com Ana, sua mulher, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se lembrou dela.
pt.R: Na manhã seguinte, bem cedo, a família adorou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Depois eles voltaram para casa, em Ramá. Elcana teve relações com a sua mulher Ana, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se lembrou dela e respondeu à oração dela.

decisions.choice: Ramah: the town of verse 1
decisions.reason: Ramah, "the height", is the short name of Ramathaim-zophim (verse 1). It stays Samuel's home all his life (7:17; 25:1).

decisions.choice: knew: had sexual relations with
decisions.reason: To "know" one's wife is a gentle way of speaking of married love (Genesis 4:1).

decisions.choice: Yahweh remembered her: he acted on her behalf
decisions.reason: When God "remembers" someone, he does not recall what he had forgotten; he turns to act for them, as he remembered Noah (Genesis 8:1) and Rachel (Genesis 30:22). Hannah had asked him to remember her (verse 11).

decisions.choice: lay with (Balanced); slept with ... and answered her prayer (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plain words for "knew" (m2). Readable adds what Yahweh's remembering meant for Hannah (m3).

decisions.choice: "ăn ở với" for "knew" at every level
decisions.reason: The idiom means sexual relations (meaning decision); "biết" would not say that in Vietnamese, while "ăn ở với" is the plain, modest word for husband and wife.

decisions.choice: "동침했고" (L); "잠자리를 같이하니" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean "알다" does not carry the Hebrew sense of "knew" (m2); Literal uses the plain written word for it.

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ לִתְקֻפ֣וֹת הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתַּ֥הַר חַנָּ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמוֹ֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י מֵיְהוָ֖ה שְׁאִלְתִּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was at [the] turnings of the days, and conceived Hannah and bore a son, and she called his name Samuel, for from Yahweh I asked him.

en.L: And it was at the turning of the days [that] Hannah conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Samuel, for [she said], "From {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I asked him."
en.B: In due time Hannah became pregnant and bore a son. She called him Samuel, for she said,"I asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for him."
en.R: Hannah became pregnant, and when the time came she had a son. She named him Samuel. She said, "I asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for him."

es.L: Y sucedió, al cumplirse los días, [que] Ana concibió y dio a luz un hijo, y llamó su nombre Samuel, porque [dijo]: «{{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} se lo pedí».
es.B: A su debido tiempo Ana quedó embarazada y dio a luz un hijo. Lo llamó Samuel, porque dijo: «Se lo pedí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.R: Ana quedó embarazada, y cuando llegó el momento tuvo un hijo. Le puso por nombre Samuel. Dijo: «Se lo pedí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et il arriva, au retour des jours, qu’Anne conçut et enfanta un fils, et elle appela son nom Samuel, car [elle dit] : « C’est {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} que je l’ai demandé. »
fr.B: Au temps voulu, Anne devint enceinte et mit au monde un fils. Elle l’appela Samuel, car elle disait : « Je l’ai demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Anne est tombée enceinte et, le moment venu, elle a eu un fils. Elle l’a appelé Samuel. Elle disait : « Je l’ai demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Na ikawa wakati wa kuzunguka kwa siku, Hana akapata mimba akazaa mwana, akamwita jina lake Samweli, kwa kuwa [alisema], "Nimemwomba kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Wakati ulipofika Hana alipata mimba akazaa mwana. Akamwita Samweli, kwa maana alisema, "Nimemwomba kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Hana alipata mimba, na wakati ulipofika akazaa mtoto wa kiume. Akampa jina Samweli. Alisema, "Nilimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anipe mtoto huyu."

vi.L: Đến kỳ của những ngày [ấy], An-ne thụ thai và sinh một con trai, và nàng đặt tên nó là Sa-mu-ên, vì [nàng nói]: "Tôi đã cầu xin nó từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Đến kỳ, An-ne có thai và sinh một con trai. Nàng đặt tên con là Sa-mu-ên, vì nàng nói: "Tôi đã cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để có nó."
vi.R: An-ne có thai, và đến ngày nàng sinh một con trai. Nàng đặt tên con là Sa-mu-ên. Nàng nói: "Tôi đã xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho tôi đứa con này."

ko.L: 그리고 날이 돌아오자 한나가 임신하여 아들을 낳았고, 그 이름을 사무엘이라고 불렀으니, "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 그를 구했다" [하고 말했기] 때문이다.
ko.B: 때가 되어 한나가 임신하여 아들을 낳았다. 한나는 "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 아이를 구했다" 하며 그 이름을 사무엘이라고 지었다.
ko.R: 한나는 임신했고, 때가 되자 아들을 낳았다. 한나는 아이의 이름을 사무엘이라고 지었다. 한나는 "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 아이를 달라고 구했다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, ao se completar o ciclo dos dias, [que] Ana concebeu e deu à luz um filho, e chamou o seu nome Samuel, pois [disse]: "{{divine_name:Do SENHOR|De Javé}} eu o pedi."
pt.B: No devido tempo, Ana ficou grávida e deu à luz um filho. Ela lhe deu o nome de Samuel, pois disse: "Eu o pedi {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}."
pt.R: Ana ficou grávida e, quando chegou a hora, teve um filho. Ela lhe deu o nome de Samuel. Ela disse: "Eu pedi este menino {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}."

decisions.choice: at the turning of the days: when the time came round
alternatives: at the turn of the year
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of the turn of the year (Exodus 34:22; 2 Chronicles 24:23). It may mean that by the next yearly visit Hannah had her son, or simply that she gave birth when the time of her pregnancy was complete. Either way the child came in God's time.

decisions.choice: Samuel: a name explained by "asked"
decisions.reason: The name Samuel, Shemu'el, most likely means "name of God" (some hear in it "heard by God"). Hannah's explanation, "from Yahweh I asked him", is a play on sound rather than a definition: the verb sha'al, "ask", echoes in the name. Scripture often gives a name its meaning from the story of a birth (Genesis 29:32-35). The same verb sounds even more like Saul, sha'ul, "asked for" (see verse 17).

decisions.choice: for from Yahweh I asked him: Hannah's own words
decisions.reason: The sentence switches to "I", so these are the words Hannah said as she named him.

decisions.choice: for [she said] (Literal); for she said (Balanced); She said (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves straight into Hannah's words without "she said"; every level supplies it so the reader knows who speaks (m3).

decisions.choice: "Sa-mu-ên", with no explanation of the sound added
decisions.reason: As the English, every level gives Hannah's words alone; the meaning decision explains the play on "asked", which the Vietnamese words cannot echo.

decisions.choice: The name "사무엘" kept, with Hannah's words "구했다" giving its explanation, as the English does
alternatives: adding "하나님께 구한 아들" after the name in the text
decisions.reason: As the English, the name stays and Hannah's words carry the link with "asked" (m2); the meaning decision gives the wordplay.

decisions.choice: Samuel; eu o pedi
decisions.reason: Portuguese, like English, cannot let the reader hear sha'al, "ask", in the name Shemu'el (m2); "pedi" keeps at least the link with Eli's "pedido" in verse 17 and Hannah's in verse 27, and the meaning note explains the sound play.

source.text: וַיַּ֛עַל הָאִ֥ישׁ אֶלְקָנָ֖ה וְכָל־בֵּית֑וֹ לִזְבֹּ֧חַ לַֽיהוָ֛ה אֶת־זֶ֥בַח הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֶת־נִדְרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went up the man Elkanah and all his house to sacrifice to Yahweh the sacrifice of the days and his vow.

en.L: And the man Elkanah and all his house went up to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
en.B: Elkanah went up with his whole household to offer {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the yearly sacrifice and to pay his vow.
en.R: Once again Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the yearly sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to keep his vow.

es.L: Y subió el hombre Elcana y toda su casa para sacrificar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} el sacrificio anual y su voto.
es.B: Elcana subió con toda su familia para ofrecer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} el sacrificio anual y cumplir su voto.
es.R: Una vez más Elcana subió con toda su familia para ofrecer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} el sacrificio de cada año y para cumplir su voto.

fr.L: Et l’homme Elqana monta avec toute sa maison pour sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} le sacrifice annuel et son vœu.
fr.B: Elqana monta avec toute sa famille pour offrir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} le sacrifice annuel et accomplir son vœu.
fr.R: Comme chaque année, Elqana est monté à Silo avec toute sa famille pour offrir le sacrifice annuel {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et pour tenir sa promesse.

sw.L: Na yule mtu Elkana na nyumba yake yote wakapanda kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya mwaka na nadhiri yake.
sw.B: Elkana alipanda pamoja na nyumba yake yote ili kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya kila mwaka na kutimiza nadhiri yake.
sw.R: Kwa mara nyingine Elkana alipanda pamoja na jamaa yake yote ili kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya kila mwaka na kutimiza nadhiri yake.

vi.L: Người chồng là Ên-ca-na cùng cả nhà mình đi lên để dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sinh tế hằng năm và [lễ vật] khấn nguyện của mình.
vi.B: Ên-ca-na cùng cả nhà đi lên dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sinh tế hằng năm và làm trọn lời khấn nguyện của mình.
vi.R: Ên-ca-na lại cùng cả gia đình đi lên dâng sinh tế hằng năm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giữ lời khấn nguyện của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그 사람 엘가나와 그의 온 집안이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 해마다 드리는 제사와 자기 서원[의 제물]을 드리려고 올라갔다.
ko.B: 엘가나는 온 가족과 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 해마다 드리는 제사를 드리고 자기 서원을 갚으려고 올라갔다.
ko.R: 엘가나는 다시 온 가족을 데리고 올라갔다. 해마다 드리는 제사를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리고 자기가 한 서원을 지키려는 것이었다.

pt.L: E o homem Elcana subiu, com toda a sua casa, para sacrificar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o sacrifício anual e o seu voto.
pt.B: Elcana subiu com toda a sua família para oferecer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o sacrifício anual e cumprir o seu voto.
pt.R: Mais uma vez, Elcana subiu com toda a família para oferecer o sacrifício anual {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e para cumprir o seu voto.

decisions.choice: the sacrifice of the days: the yearly sacrifice
decisions.reason: "Days" means a year, as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: his vow: a vow of Elkanah's own, or his share in Hannah's vow
decisions.reason: The story has not mentioned a vow of Elkanah's. He may have made one of his own, perhaps in thanks for the son. Or "his vow" may be Hannah's vow, which he had let stand as her husband and so made his own (Numbers 30:11-16). A vow was often paid with a sacrifice (Leviticus 7:16; Deuteronomy 12:6).

decisions.choice: to pay his vow (Balanced); to keep his vow (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins "his vow" to the verb "sacrifice"; Balanced and Readable supply a verb that fits a vow. Readable adds "Once again" to show that this is the next yearly visit.

source.text: וְחַנָּ֖ה לֹ֣א עָלָ֑תָה כִּֽי־אָמְרָ֣ה לְאִישָׁ֗הּ עַ֣ד יִגָּמֵ֤ל הַנַּ֨עַר֙ וַהֲבִאֹתִ֗יו וְנִרְאָה֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְיָ֥שַׁב שָׁ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, Until is weaned the boy; and I will bring him, and he will appear [before the] face of Yahweh and dwell there until forever.

en.L: But Hannah did not go up, for she said to her husband, "[Not] until the boy is weaned; then I will bring him, and he will appear before the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and dwell there forever."
en.B: But Hannah did not go. She told her husband, "Once the boy is weaned, I will bring him to appear before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he will stay there for the rest of his life."
en.R: But Hannah stayed home. She told her husband, "When the boy no longer needs to nurse, I will take him to Shiloh. He will be presented to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and live there for the rest of his life."

es.L: Pero Ana no subió, porque dijo a su marido: «[No] hasta que el niño sea destetado; entonces lo llevaré, y se presentará ante el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y se quedará allí para siempre».
es.B: Pero Ana no fue. Le dijo a su marido: «Cuando el niño esté destetado, lo llevaré para que se presente delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y se quedará allí el resto de su vida».
es.R: Pero Ana se quedó en casa. Le dijo a su marido: «Cuando el niño ya no necesite mamar, lo llevaré a Silo. Será presentado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y vivirá allí el resto de su vida».

fr.L: Mais Anne ne monta pas, car elle dit à son mari : « [Pas] avant que l’enfant soit sevré ; alors je l’amènerai, et il paraîtra devant la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et il demeurera là pour toujours. »
fr.B: Mais Anne n’y alla pas. Elle dit à son mari : « Quand l’enfant sera sevré, je l’amènerai pour qu’il paraisse devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et il restera là-bas pour le reste de sa vie. »
fr.R: Mais Anne est restée à la maison. Elle a dit à son mari : « Quand l’enfant n’aura plus besoin d’être allaité, je l’emmènerai à Silo. Il sera présenté {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et il vivra là-bas toute sa vie. »

sw.L: Lakini Hana hakupanda, kwa maana alimwambia mumewe, "[Sitapanda] mpaka mtoto aachishwe kunyonya; ndipo nitamleta, naye ataonekana mbele ya uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kukaa huko milele."
sw.B: Lakini Hana hakwenda. Alimwambia mumewe, "Mtoto akishaachishwa kunyonya, nitamleta aonekane mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye atakaa huko maisha yake yote."
sw.R: Lakini Hana alibaki nyumbani. Alimwambia mumewe, "Mtoto atakapoacha kunyonya, nitampeleka Shilo. Atakabidhiwa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuishi huko maisha yake yote."

vi.L: Nhưng An-ne không đi lên, vì nàng nói với chồng: "[Đợi] cho đến khi đứa trẻ thôi bú; rồi tôi sẽ đem nó lên, và nó sẽ ra mắt trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và ở đó mãi mãi."
vi.B: Nhưng An-ne không đi. Nàng nói với chồng: "Khi nào đứa trẻ thôi bú, em sẽ đem nó lên để ra mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nó sẽ ở lại đó suốt đời."
vi.R: Nhưng An-ne ở nhà. Nàng nói với chồng: "Khi nào con thôi bú, em sẽ đưa con lên Si-lô. Con sẽ được dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sống ở đó suốt đời."

ko.L: 그러나 한나는 올라가지 않았으니, 그 여자가 자기 남편에게 "아이가 젖을 뗄 때까지는 [가지 않겠어요]. 그때 내가 그를 데리고 가서, 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴 앞에 나타나 거기에서 영원히 살게 하겠어요" 하고 말했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 한나는 올라가지 않았다. 한나는 남편에게 말했다. "아이가 젖을 떼면, 내가 그 아이를 데리고 가서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 보이겠어요. 그러면 그 아이는 평생 거기에서 살 거예요."
ko.R: 그러나 한나는 집에 남았다. 한나는 남편에게 말했다. "아이가 더 이상 젖을 먹지 않게 되면, 내가 아이를 실로로 데려갈게요. 그 아이를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치고, 아이는 평생 거기에서 살 거예요."

pt.L: Mas Ana não subiu, pois disse ao seu marido: "[Não irei] até que o menino seja desmamado; então eu o levarei, e ele aparecerá diante da face {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e ficará ali para sempre."
pt.B: Mas Ana não foi. Ela disse ao marido: "Assim que o menino for desmamado, eu o levarei para que ele se apresente diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e ele ficará lá pelo resto da vida."
pt.R: Mas Ana ficou em casa. Ela disse ao marido: "Quando o menino não precisar mais mamar, eu vou levá-lo a Siló. Ele vai ser apresentado {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e vai morar lá pelo resto da vida."

decisions.choice: weaned: perhaps two or three years old
decisions.reason: Children were nursed much longer than is usual today, often for two or three years, and a feast could mark the weaning (Genesis 21:8). Samuel would still be a small child when he came to Shiloh (verse 24), but old enough to be cared for by others and to serve (2:11, 18).

decisions.choice: appear before Yahweh: be presented at his sanctuary
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of Israel's men appearing before Yahweh at the yearly feasts (Exodus 23:17; 34:23; Deuteronomy 16:16). Samuel will appear there not for a feast but to stay.

decisions.choice: until forever: for good, all his life
decisions.reason: "Until forever" here means permanently, for the whole of his life, as Hannah vowed (verse 11) and says again in verse 28.

decisions.choice: [Not] until
decisions.reason: Hannah's words begin with "until", leaving "I will not go up" to be understood from the start of the verse; Literal supplies "Not".

decisions.choice: stayed home; no longer needs to nurse; to Shiloh
decisions.reason: Readable explains "weaned" and names the place where the LORD's house was (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Hannah calls herself "em" to Elkanah (B, R); Literal keeps "tôi"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Hannah calls her husband "anh" and herself "em"; Literal keeps the plain first person, as the Genesis note allows for a wife's formal speech.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהּ֩ אֶלְקָנָ֨ה אִישָׁ֜הּ עֲשִׂ֧י הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינַ֗יִךְ שְׁבִי֙ עַד־גָּמְלֵ֣ךְ אֹת֔וֹ אַ֛ךְ יָקֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־דְּבָר֑וֹ וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וַתֵּ֣ינֶק אֶת־בְּנָ֔הּ עַד־גָּמְלָ֖הּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to her Elkanah her husband, Do the good in your eyes; stay until you have weaned him; only may establish Yahweh his word. And stayed the woman and nursed her son until she weaned him.

en.L: And Elkanah her husband said to her, "Do what [is] good in your eyes; stay until you have weaned him; only may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} establish {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word." So the woman stayed and nursed her son until she weaned him.
en.B: Her husband Elkanah told her, "Do what seems best to you. Stay at home until you have weaned him. Only may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word come true." So the woman stayed home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.
en.R: Her husband Elkanah said to her, "Do whatever you think is best. Stay here until he no longer needs to nurse. I only pray that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has said." So Hannah stayed home and nursed her son until he was old enough to stop.

es.L: Y Elcana su marido le dijo: «Haz lo que [es] bueno a tus ojos; quédate hasta que lo hayas destetado; solamente que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} confirme {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra». Y la mujer se quedó y amamantó a su hijo hasta que lo destetó.
es.B: Su marido Elcana le dijo: «Haz lo que te parezca mejor. Quédate en casa hasta que lo hayas destetado. Solo pido que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga realidad {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra». Así que la mujer se quedó en casa y amamantó a su hijo hasta destetarlo.
es.R: Su marido Elcana le dijo: «Haz lo que te parezca mejor. Quédate aquí hasta que el niño ya no necesite mamar. Solo pido que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga lo que ha dicho». Así que Ana se quedó en casa y amamantó a su hijo hasta que tuvo edad para dejar el pecho.

fr.L: Et Elqana son mari lui dit : « Fais ce qui [est] bon à tes yeux ; reste jusqu’à ce que tu l’aies sevré ; seulement, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accomplisse {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole. » Et la femme resta et allaita son fils jusqu’à ce qu’elle l’eût sevré.
fr.B: Son mari Elqana lui répondit : « Fais ce qui te semble bon. Reste à la maison jusqu’à ce que tu l’aies sevré. Seulement, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} réalise {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole ! » La femme resta donc et allaita son fils jusqu’à ce qu’elle l’eût sevré.
fr.R: Son mari Elqana lui a dit : « Fais ce qui te semble le mieux. Reste ici jusqu’à ce qu’il n’ait plus besoin d’être allaité. Je prie seulement pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fasse ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit. » Alors Anne est restée à la maison et elle a allaité son fils jusqu’à ce qu’il soit assez grand pour arrêter.

sw.L: Na Elkana mumewe akamwambia, "Fanya [lililo] jema machoni pako; kaa mpaka umemwachisha kunyonya; ila {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na alithibitishe neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}." Basi yule mwanamke akakaa, akamnyonyesha mwanawe mpaka alipomwachisha kunyonya.
sw.B: Mumewe Elkana akamwambia, "Fanya unavyoona ni vyema. Kaa nyumbani mpaka umwachishe kunyonya. Ila {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na alitimize neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}." Basi yule mwanamke akabaki nyumbani akamnyonyesha mwanawe mpaka alipomwachisha.
sw.R: Mumewe Elkana akamwambia, "Fanya lolote unaloona ni bora. Kaa hapa mpaka mtoto aache kunyonya. Ninaomba tu kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatimiza alichosema." Basi Hana akabaki nyumbani akamnyonyesha mwanawe mpaka alipokuwa mkubwa wa kutosha kuacha.

vi.L: Ên-ca-na chồng nàng nói với nàng: "Hãy làm điều tốt trong mắt em; hãy ở lại cho đến khi em cho nó thôi bú; chỉ nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm vững lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." Vậy người đàn bà ở lại và cho con bú cho đến khi nàng cho nó thôi bú.
vi.B: Ên-ca-na chồng nàng bảo: "Em thấy thế nào là tốt thì cứ làm. Hãy ở nhà cho đến khi con thôi bú. Chỉ nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được thành tựu." Vậy người đàn bà ở nhà nuôi con cho đến khi con thôi bú.
vi.R: Ên-ca-na chồng nàng nói: "Em thấy sao là tốt nhất thì cứ làm. Hãy ở nhà cho đến khi con thôi bú. Anh chỉ cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán." Vậy An-ne ở nhà cho con bú cho đến khi con đủ lớn để thôi bú.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자의 남편 엘가나가 그 여자에게 말했다. "당신 눈에 좋은 대로 해요. 그 아이가 젖을 뗄 때까지 머물러요. 다만 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 말씀을 이루시기를 바라요." 그래서 그 여자는 머물러 그 아들이 젖을 뗄 때까지 젖을 먹였다.
ko.B: 남편 엘가나가 한나에게 말했다. "당신이 좋을 대로 해요. 아이가 젖을 뗄 때까지 집에 있어요. 다만 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 말씀을 이루어 주시기를 바랄 뿐이에요." 그래서 한나는 집에 머물면서 아이가 젖을 뗄 때까지 젖을 먹였다.
ko.R: 남편 엘가나가 한나에게 말했다. "당신 생각에 가장 좋은 대로 해요. 아이가 젖을 뗄 때까지 여기 있어요. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 이루어 주시기만 기도할게요." 그래서 한나는 집에 남아 아이가 젖을 뗄 만큼 클 때까지 젖을 먹였다.

pt.L: E Elcana, o seu marido, lhe disse: "Faça o [que é] bom aos seus olhos; fique até que você o tenha desmamado; somente que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} confirme a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra." E a mulher ficou e amamentou o seu filho até desmamá-lo.
pt.B: O marido dela, Elcana, respondeu: "Faça o que você achar melhor. Fique em casa até desmamá-lo. Apenas, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} cumpra a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra." Então a mulher ficou em casa e amamentou o filho até desmamá-lo.
pt.R: O marido dela, Elcana, disse: "Faça o que você achar melhor. Fique aqui até que ele não precise mais mamar. Eu só peço que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse." Então Ana ficou em casa e amamentou o filho até ele ter idade para deixar de mamar.

decisions.choice: Do what is good in your eyes: Elkanah agrees to her plan
decisions.reason: As her husband he could have cancelled her vow (Numbers 30:11-16). Instead he lets her decide when to bring the boy, and so he confirms the vow.

decisions.choice: may Yahweh establish his word: the Hebrew text
alternatives: may Yahweh establish what has gone out of your mouth (ancient Greek, Qumran)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "his word", meaning Yahweh's. No word of Yahweh about the boy has been reported; it may mean Eli's blessing taken as Yahweh's promise (verse 17), or Yahweh's purpose in giving the child. The ancient Greek translation and a Hebrew manuscript from Qumran read "what has gone out of your mouth", that is, may Yahweh help Hannah to keep her vow. The Hebrew text is followed here; reviewers should check the readings.

decisions.choice: make his word come true (Balanced); do what he has said (Readable); Hannah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what it means for the LORD to "establish" a word. Readable names Hannah for "the woman" and explains "weaned".

source.text: וַתַּעֲלֵ֨הוּ עִמָּ֜הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר גְּמָלַ֗תּוּ בְּפָרִ֤ים שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ וְאֵיפָ֨ה אַחַ֥ת קֶ֨מַח֙ וְנֵ֣בֶל יַ֔יִן וַתְּבִאֵ֥הוּ בֵית־יְהוָ֖ה שִׁל֑וֹ וְהַנַּ֖עַר נָֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: And she brought him up with her when she had weaned him, with three bulls and one ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him [to the] house of Yahweh [at] Shiloh; and the boy [was] a boy.

en.L: And she brought him up with her when she had weaned him, with three bulls, and one ephah of flour, and a skin of wine, and she brought him to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [at] Shiloh; and the boy [was] young.
en.B: Once she had weaned him, she took him up with her, along with three bulls, {{units:about 20 quarts|an ephah}} of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Shiloh. The boy was still young.
en.R: When Samuel was weaned, Hannah took him with her to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Shiloh. She also took three bulls, {{units:about 20 quarts|an ephah}} of flour, and a leather bag of wine. Samuel was still very young.

es.L: Y lo subió consigo cuando lo hubo destetado, con tres toros, un efa de harina y un odre de vino, y lo llevó a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [en] Silo; y el niño [era] pequeño.
es.B: Cuando lo hubo destetado, lo subió consigo junto con tres toros, {{units:unos 22 litros|un efa}} de harina y un odre de vino, y lo llevó a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Silo. El niño todavía era pequeño.
es.R: Cuando Samuel fue destetado, Ana lo llevó consigo a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Silo. También llevó tres toros, {{units:unos 22 litros|un efa}} de harina y una bolsa de cuero llena de vino. Samuel era todavía muy pequeño.

fr.L: Et elle le fit monter avec elle quand elle l’eut sevré, avec trois taureaux, et un épha de farine, et une outre de vin, et elle l’amena à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [à] Silo ; et l’enfant [était] jeune.
fr.B: Une fois qu’elle l’eut sevré, elle l’emmena avec elle, ainsi que trois taureaux, {{units:environ 22 litres|un épha}} de farine et une outre de vin, et elle l’amena à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Silo. L’enfant était encore jeune.
fr.R: Quand Samuel a été sevré, Anne l’a emmené avec elle à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, à Silo. Elle a aussi emporté trois taureaux, {{units:environ 22 litres|un épha}} de farine et un sac de cuir rempli de vin. Samuel était encore très petit.

sw.L: Naye akampandisha pamoja naye alipokwisha kumwachisha kunyonya, pamoja na mafahali watatu, na efa moja ya unga, na kiriba cha divai, akamleta nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [huko] Shilo; na mtoto [alikuwa] mdogo.
sw.B: Alipokwisha kumwachisha kunyonya, alimpandisha pamoja naye, pamoja na mafahali watatu, {{units:karibu lita 22 za unga|efa moja ya unga}} na kiriba cha divai, akamleta nyumbani mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Shilo. Mtoto alikuwa bado mdogo.
sw.R: Samweli alipoacha kunyonya, Hana alimchukua pamoja naye mpaka nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Shilo. Alichukua pia mafahali watatu, {{units:karibu lita 22 za unga|efa moja ya unga}}, na mfuko wa ngozi wenye divai. Samweli alikuwa bado mdogo sana.

vi.L: Khi đã cho nó thôi bú, nàng đem nó lên với mình, cùng với ba con bò đực, một ê-pha bột và một bầu da rượu, và đem nó vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [tại] Si-lô; và đứa trẻ [còn] nhỏ.
vi.B: Khi con đã thôi bú, nàng đem con lên cùng với ba con bò đực, {{units:khoảng 22 lít|một ê-pha}} bột và một bầu da rượu, đưa con vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Si-lô. Đứa trẻ vẫn còn nhỏ.
vi.R: Khi Sa-mu-ên thôi bú, An-ne đem con lên nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở Si-lô. Nàng cũng đem theo ba con bò đực, {{units:khoảng 22 lít|một ê-pha}} bột và một túi da đựng rượu. Sa-mu-ên vẫn còn rất nhỏ.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 아이가 젖을 떼자, 수소 세 마리와 밀가루 한 에바와 포도주 한 가죽 부대와 함께 그를 데리고 올라가, 실로에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 그를 데려갔다. 그리고 그 아이는 어렸다.
ko.B: 한나는 아이가 젖을 떼자, 수소 세 마리와 밀가루 {{units:약 22리터|한 에바}}와 포도주 한 부대를 가지고 아이를 데리고 올라가, 실로에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 데려갔다. 아이는 아직 어렸다.
ko.R: 사무엘이 젖을 떼자, 한나는 아이를 데리고 실로에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 갔다. 한나는 수소 세 마리와 밀가루 {{units:약 22리터|한 에바}}와 포도주 한 가죽 부대도 가지고 갔다. 사무엘은 아직 아주 어렸다.

pt.L: E ela o fez subir com ela quando o desmamou, com três novilhos, e um efa de farinha, e um odre de vinho, e o levou à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [em] Siló; e o menino [era] pequeno.
pt.B: Depois de desmamá-lo, ela o levou consigo, com três novilhos, {{units:cerca de 22 litros|um efa}} de farinha e um odre de vinho, e o levou à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Siló. O menino ainda era pequeno.
pt.R: Quando Samuel foi desmamado, Ana o levou à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Siló. Ela levou também três novilhos, {{units:cerca de 22 litros|um efa}} de farinha e uma bolsa de couro cheia de vinho. Samuel ainda era muito pequeno.

decisions.choice: three bulls: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "three bulls", but verse 25 speaks of "the bull". The ancient Greek translation and a Hebrew manuscript from Qumran read "a bull three years old", which differs only slightly in the Hebrew letters and fits verse 25. With three bulls, "the bull" of verse 25 is the one offered when the boy was presented. The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: an ephah of flour and a skin of wine: a generous offering
decisions.reason: An ephah was about 20 quarts. Flour and wine went with a bull offered as a sacrifice (Numbers 15:8-10 asks three tenths of an ephah of flour and half a hin of wine for each bull); Hannah brings far more. The word for the wine container can mean a leather skin or a large clay jar (Jeremiah 13:12).

decisions.choice: the boy was a boy: the child was still young
decisions.reason: Repeating the word stresses how young he was: a little child, just weaned, given to the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: Samuel; a leather bag of wine
decisions.reason: Readable names Samuel and Hannah for "him" and "she", and says what a skin was.

decisions.choice: {{units:environ 22 litres|un épha}}
decisions.reason: French readers use metric measures, so the default gives the ephah in litres (22 litres, the value of the Pentateuch note), with the original measure as the alternative; Literal keeps "un épha", as the English Literal keeps "ephah". This holds for every measure in 1 Samuel.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 22 litros|un efa}}; Literal "un efa"
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Pentateuch note: where the English converts a measure, Spanish converts to metric (ephah 22 litres, shekel 11,5 g, cubit 45 cm), with the original unit as the reader setting; Literal keeps the original unit, as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu lita 22 za unga|efa moja ya unga}}
decisions.reason: As the terms notes, Swahili gives measures in metric by default (an ephah is about 22 litres) with the original unit as the alternative; Literal keeps "efa".

decisions.choice: "khoảng 22 lít" by default, "một ê-pha" with the Measures setting; Literal keeps "một ê-pha"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese uses metric measures by default, at the value the Samuel terms note sets for an ephah.

decisions.choice: "{{units:약 22리터|한 에바}}"
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide and the terms note: metric by default (an ephah taken as 22 litres), the original unit as the alternative; Literal keeps "한 에바", as the English Literal does. Used for the whole block.

decisions.choice: cerca de 22 litros (default), um efa (alternative)
decisions.reason: Portuguese gives the metric measure by default, with the Hebrew unit as the alternative, where the English gives US quarts (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md: an ephah is 22 litres). Literal keeps "um efa".

decisions.choice: novilhos
decisions.reason: "Novilho", a young bull, is the word the Pentateuch uses in Portuguese for the bull of a sacrifice (Exodus 29:1); it also fits verse 25.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת־הַפָּ֑ר וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת־הַנַּ֖עַר אֶל־עֵלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And they slaughtered the bull, and they brought the boy to Eli.

en.L: And they slaughtered the bull, and they brought the boy to Eli.
en.B: They slaughtered the bull and brought the boy to Eli.
en.R: After they had killed the bull as a sacrifice, they brought the boy to Eli.

es.L: Y degollaron el toro, y trajeron al niño a Elí.
es.B: Sacrificaron el toro y llevaron al niño ante Elí.
es.R: Después de matar el toro como sacrificio, llevaron al niño a Elí.

fr.L: Et ils égorgèrent le taureau, et ils amenèrent l’enfant à Éli.
fr.B: Ils égorgèrent le taureau et amenèrent l’enfant à Éli.
fr.R: Ils ont tué le taureau pour l’offrir en sacrifice, puis ils ont amené l’enfant à Éli.

sw.L: Nao wakamchinja yule fahali, wakamleta mtoto kwa Eli.
sw.B: Wakamchinja yule fahali, wakamleta mtoto kwa Eli.
sw.R: Walipokwisha kumchinja yule fahali kama dhabihu, walimleta mtoto kwa Eli.

vi.L: Họ giết con bò đực, và đem đứa trẻ đến với Hê-li.
vi.B: Họ giết con bò đực rồi đem đứa trẻ đến với Hê-li.
vi.R: Sau khi giết con bò đực làm sinh tế, họ đưa đứa trẻ đến với Hê-li.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 수소를 잡고 그 아이를 엘리에게 데려갔다.
ko.B: 그들은 수소를 잡고 아이를 엘리에게 데려갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 수소를 잡아 제물로 바친 뒤에, 아이를 엘리에게 데려갔다.

pt.L: E eles imolaram o novilho e trouxeram o menino a Eli.
pt.B: Eles abateram o novilho e levaram o menino a Eli.
pt.R: Depois de matar o novilho como sacrifício, eles levaram o menino a Eli.

decisions.choice: slaughtered the bull: the sacrifice that marked the boy's presentation
decisions.reason: The bull was killed as an offering, probably a burnt offering given wholly to Yahweh (Leviticus 1:3-5), as Samuel himself was being given wholly to him. On the number of bulls, see verse 24.

decisions.choice: as a sacrifice
decisions.reason: Readable says why the bull was killed.

source.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י חֵ֥י נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֑י אֲנִ֣י הָאִשָּׁ֗ה הַנִּצֶּ֤בֶת עִמְּכָה֙ בָּזֶ֔ה לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said, Please, my lord, [by the] life of your soul, my lord, I [am] the woman standing with you in this [place] to pray to Yahweh.

en.L: And she said, "Please, my lord! [As] your soul lives, my lord, I [am] the woman who stood beside you here, praying to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Hannah said, "Pardon me, my lord! As surely as you live, my lord, I am the woman who once stood beside you here, praying to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Hannah said to Eli, "Excuse me, sir. I promise you, I am the woman who stood here next to you and prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y ella dijo: «¡Oh, mi señor! [Así como] vive tu alma, mi señor, yo [soy] la mujer que estuvo aquí junto a ti orando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Ana dijo: «¡Perdón, mi señor! Tan cierto como que vives, mi señor, yo soy la mujer que estuvo aquí junto a ti, orando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Ana le dijo a Elí: «Disculpa, señor. Te aseguro que yo soy la mujer que estuvo aquí a tu lado orando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et elle dit : « Pardon, mon seigneur ! [Aussi vrai que] ton âme vit, mon seigneur, je [suis] la femme qui se tenait près de toi ici, pour prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Anne dit : « Pardon, mon seigneur ! Aussi vrai que tu es vivant, mon seigneur, je suis la femme qui se tenait ici près de toi pour prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Anne a dit à Éli : « Excuse-moi, monsieur. Je t’assure que je suis la femme qui se tenait ici, à côté de toi, et qui priait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Tafadhali, bwana wangu! [Kama] nafsi yako iishivyo, bwana wangu, mimi [ndimi] mwanamke aliyesimama karibu nawe hapa, akimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hana akasema, "Samahani, bwana wangu! Kama uishivyo, bwana wangu, mimi ndimi yule mwanamke aliyewahi kusimama karibu nawe hapa, akimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hana akamwambia Eli, "Samahani, bwana. Nakuhakikishia, mimi ndiye yule mwanamke aliyesimama hapa karibu nawe akimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Nàng nói: "Xin thưa chúa tôi! [Thật như] linh hồn ông đang sống, thưa chúa tôi, tôi [là] người đàn bà đã đứng bên ông ở đây để cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: An-ne nói: "Thưa chúa tôi, xin cho tôi được nói! Thật như ông đang sống, thưa chúa tôi, tôi là người đàn bà đã có lần đứng bên ông ở đây mà cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 말했다. "내 주여, 부디 [들어 주십시오]! 내 주의 영혼이 살아 계심을 두고 [말씀드립니다]. 저는 여기서 내 주 곁에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하던 그 여자입니다.

ko.R: 한나가 엘리에게 말했다. "제사장님, 잠깐 실례합니다. 정말입니다. 저는 전에 여기 제사장님 옆에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하던 그 여자입니다.

pt.L: E ela disse: "Por favor, meu senhor! [Tão certo como] vive a sua alma, meu senhor, eu [sou] a mulher que esteve aqui ao seu lado, orando {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Ana disse: "Com licença, meu senhor! Tão certo como o senhor vive, meu senhor, eu sou a mulher que um dia esteve aqui ao seu lado, orando {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Ana disse a Eli: "Com licença, senhor. Eu garanto ao senhor que sou a mulher que esteve aqui ao seu lado, orando {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: please, my lord: asking leave to speak
decisions.reason: Bi, "please" or "pardon me", is how one asks a superior to listen (Genesis 43:20; Judges 6:13).

decisions.choice: as your soul lives: an oath, "as surely as you live"
decisions.reason: Swearing by a person's life was a solemn way to assure them that what follows is true (17:55; 20:3; 25:26). Some years have passed, and Hannah assures Eli that she is the woman he saw.

decisions.choice: the woman who stood beside you here: the scene of verses 9-18
decisions.reason: Hannah points back to the place and the prayer that Eli saw, so that he will see what Yahweh has done.

decisions.choice: Excuse me, sir. I promise you
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday polite address and gives the sense of the oath (m2). It names Eli as the one she speaks to.

decisions.choice: "내 주의 영혼이 살아 계심을 두고" (L); "제사장님께서 살아 계심을 두고" (B); "정말입니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The oath by Eli's life takes the honorific "계심" in Korean, since Hannah speaks to a priest; Readable says plainly that she is promising, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: granted him ... granted: handed over in answer to asking
decisions.reason: The verb is sha'al again, "ask", in a form that means to let someone have what was asked, to grant or hand over (Exodus 12:36 uses it of the Egyptians giving Israel what it asked). It is not a loan to be taken back: the boy belongs to Yahweh "all the days that he lives". Hannah asked Yahweh for him, and now she gives him to Yahweh as one "asked", sha'ul, a word that sounds like the name Saul.

decisions.choice: I in turn: Hannah answers Yahweh's gift with her own
decisions.reason: "And also I" sets Hannah's act beside Yahweh's: he gave her what she asked (verse 27), and she in turn gives the boy to him.

decisions.choice: he worshiped there: Elkanah, or the boy Samuel
decisions.reason: The verb is singular, "he bowed down". It may refer to Elkanah, the head of the family, or to the young Samuel, whose life before Yahweh begins here. Some Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Latin translation read "they worshiped".

decisions.choice: granted (Literal); give, given over (Balanced); giving, belong (Readable)
decisions.reason: Familiar English versions say "lent", which keeps the repeated word but suggests a loan to be returned. Literal says "granted" twice, which keeps the repeated word with the right sense; Balanced and Readable say what the verb means (m1).

decisions.choice: "cédé" (Literal); "donne", "remis" (Balanced); "donne", "appartiendra" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on "asked" (verses 20, 27): what Hannah asked of the LORD she now hands over to him (m1). French has no verb that is both "ask" and "lend", so the levels follow the English choices; "prêté", the old rendering, would suggest the gift was only for a time, against "all the days that he lives".

decisions.choice: "cedido" (L); "entrego", "entregado" (B); "entrego", "pertenecerá" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English decision: "prestado" (lent) would suggest a loan to be returned, while Hannah gives Samuel for life (m1). Literal repeats one verb, "ceder", for the repeated Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: nimemtoa, ametolewa (L); ninamtoa, amekabidhiwa (B); ninamtoa, mali ya (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on "ask" (lend, grant on request); Swahili has no verb that both asks and grants, so it says what Hannah does, handing him over for good, and leaves the wordplay to the meaning decision (m1).

decisions.choice: "người" for "he" who worshiped
decisions.reason: The subject may be Elkanah or the boy (meaning decision); "người" leaves it open, as the English "he" does.

decisions.choice: "바칩니다 ... 바쳐진" (L); "드립니다 ... 바쳐진" (B); "드립니다 ... 의 것입니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on "asked" and "granted" (m1); Korean cannot keep one verb root for both, so it says the giving plainly; the meaning decision explains the wordplay.

decisions.choice: concedi, concedido (L); entrego, entregue (B); entregando, pertencer (R)
decisions.reason: Familiar Portuguese versions say "emprestar", which suggests a loan to be taken back (m1). Literal says "conceder" twice, the verb of Eli's blessing in verse 17 ("lhe conceda o seu pedido") and of verse 27: the LORD granted Hannah her request, and she grants the boy to him in turn (m2). Balanced and Readable say she hands him over, as the English does.
